original:
रात्रौ प्रसुप्तं शिबिरं पाण्डवानां दुरासदम् ।
प्रविश्य द्रोणपुत्रेण कृतं संकदनं महत् ॥
sanskrit:
रात्रौ प्रसुप्तं शिबिरं पाण्डवानां दुरासदम् ।
प्रविश्य द्रोणपुत्रेण कृतं संकदनं महत् ॥
transliteration:
rātrau prasuptaṃ śibiraṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ durāsadam |
praviśya droṇaputreṇa kṛtaṃ saṃkadanaṃ mahat ||
translation: Entering the slumbering camp of the Pandavas in the dead of night, Ashwatthama wrought terrible devastation.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: रात्रि में जब पाण्डव शिविर सो रहा था, तब द्रोणपुत्र अश्वत्थामा ने प्रवेश कर भीषण संहार किया।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: रात्रीच्या वेळी जेव्हा पांडव छावणी निद्रिस्त होती, तेव्हा द्रोणपुत्र अश्वत्थाम्याने प्रवेश करून भयानक संहार केला.

layers.author: km_ganguli
layers.content: Sauptika Parva explores the tragic moral breakdown that follows desperate vengeance, leading to the curse upon Ashwatthama.

layers.author: nilakantha
layers.content: Symbolizes how uncontrolled anger destroys even the victorious when righteous restraints are abandoned.
